737:t_127:5.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「They're our enemies... the enemies of all life!」

737:t_127:6.en:
$$シン$$
「I'll show you, $$御使い$$s! I'll show you the power born from the little lives you look down on!」

737:t_127:7.en:
$$シン$$
「I won't forgive war or those who bring it about! I'll never forgive you!!」

737:t_128:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「You forgot your feelings, and only your power evolved...!」

737:t_128:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「A human actually said that to us! Even though we're $$御使い$$s!」

737:t_128:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You don't know your place...! You will pay for your actions!」

737:t_128:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「Feelings alone aren't enough, and neither is power alone...!」

737:t_128:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「You've forgotten compassion and the will to live together with others. The power you wield is nothing but violence!」

737:t_128:5.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Be silent, powerless ones! You are merely immature weaklings!」

737:t_128:6.en:
$$キラ$$
「I... we won't lose to something like that! We mustn't lose!!」

737:t_128:7.en:
$$キラ$$
「That's why I'll fight! I'll stake my life on it!!」

737:t_129:1.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「One who could not reach the threshold of evolution dares oppose us.」

737:t_129:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「There are things I can do even without becoming a $$ニュータイプ$$! That's why I'm here!」

737:t_129:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Huh? You're not going to say it's defeating us, are you?」

737:t_129:4.en:
$$シャア$$
「That's exactly it...! Even if I cannot defeat you, I can at least sacrifice myself for those who follow!」

737:t_129:5.en:
$$シャア$$
「Don't underestimate humanity, $$御使い$$s! We are moving toward the future faster than you imagine!!」

737:t_130:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I confirm the target. My attack targets are the $$御使い$$s.」

737:t_130:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「No way! He isn't the least bit afraid of us!?」

737:t_130:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So he is too inferior even to feel fear?」

737:t_130:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Is that all you have to say?」

737:t_130:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I have no intention of talking with you.」

737:t_130:6.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「How insolent! Someone like you deserves...」

737:t_130:9.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I'll end it. All of it...!」

737:t_131:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「I'll fly on wings carrying our feelings to defeat you!」

737:t_131:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「See... They're inferior, so they still bother with things like romance.」

737:t_131:3.en:
$$アルト$$
「It looks like becoming one made you into boring creatures!」

737:t_131:4.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「A mere human would deny the existence of the $$御使い$$s!?」

737:t_131:5.en:
$$アルト$$
「You abandoned understanding each other and sharing your feelings forever! That's why you don't understand life's meaning or value!」

737:t_131:6.en:
$$アルト$$
「I won't hand our freedom, dreams, or love over to boring creatures like you!」

737:t_131:7.en:
$$アルト$$
「It's over, $$御使い$$s! I'll show you the power my feelings create!!」

737:t_132:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「It's the final stage! Let's make it a blast!」

737:t_132:1.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「OK! I'm going all out too!」

737:t_132:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「It's noisy...! Noisy! Stop that singing!」

737:t_132:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Your noise disrupts the universe! Your existence brings nothing but harm!」

737:t_132:4.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Don't knock it before you try it! Feel my soul with your heart!」

737:t_132:5.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Wh-what...!? The sound... the melody... keeps coming into me!」

737:t_132:6.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「It is the lost power... $$アニマスピリチア$$...!」

737:t_132:7.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Like I care about some title!」

737:t_132:8.en:
$$バサラ$$
「$$御使い$$s! Listen to my soooooong!!」

737:t_133:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Why is a $$人類銀河同盟$$ $$マシンキャリバー$$ here?」

737:t_133:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「He's the odd specimen I told you about. He drifted to Earth and its influence made him think he was human.」

737:t_133:3.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「It seems the stimulation of primitive living corrupted you.」

737:t_133:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「If you were still part of the $$人類銀河同盟$$, we would've let you live to fight the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$.」

737:t_133:6.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「From the preceding conversation, I infer that an organization similar to $$クロノ$$ existed within the $$人類銀河同盟$$.」

737:t_133:7.en:
$$レド$$
「So they made the Alliance fight the $$ヒディアーズ#keyword$$, who were originally human...!」

737:t_133:9.en:
$$レド$$
「...I am human! And I'm a warrior who fights of his own free will!」

737:t_133:10.en:
$$レド$$
「My mission is to fight to protect lives from beings like you!」

737:t_133:11.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「I fully agree. I will support Ensign $$レド$$ with all my capabilities.」

737:t_134:0.en:
$$宗介$$
「Dictators always perish eventually! That's the way of the world!」

737:t_134:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「How stupid! Who decided that!?」

737:t_134:2.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「We are the $$御使い$$s...! In the Supreme God's name, we decide the entire fate of the universe!」

737:t_134:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「But we won't do what you want! I'll show you the proof right now!」

737:t_134:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「You're so insolent! This guy pisses me off!」

737:t_134:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Feel free to hate me! I have absolutely no intention of being liked by my enemies!」

737:t_134:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Brace yourselves! I'll fill this fucking miserable remnant of Earth with your screams and the wreckage of that junk heap!」

737:t_134:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「You would do such a thing...」

737:t_134:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「You have no right to refuse! I decide everything!!」

737:t_135:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「Oh... So this man is the heir to that civilization.」

737:t_135:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「From your reaction, it seems you know about $$ギアス$$ too.」

737:t_135:2.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Of course. There's nothing the $$御使い$$s don't know.」

737:t_135:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then answer me. Tell me what I'm thinking right now.」

737:t_135:4.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Easy! You're scheming up some underhanded way to outwit us, right?」

737:t_135:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「You don't live up to your boasts, $$御使い$$s.」

737:t_135:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Victory is all I'm thinking about! I'll crush you head-on!」

737:t_135:7.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「So you are merely foolish humans! You don't seem to understand the overwhelming gap in our power!」

737:t_135:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(They possess eternal life and look down on humans... That's where our chance of victory lies...!)

737:t_135:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(A chance will surely come...! That will be the moment to spend my life!)

737:t_136:0.en:
$$ドクトリン$$
「$$異能生存体$$... You are one of the miracles born from the universe.」

737:t_136:1.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「But the $$御使い$$s transcend causality too. So your ability won't work on us.」

737:t_136:3.en:
$$テンプティ$$
「Like I said! I'm telling you that won't work!」

737:t_136:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「I will live... by defeating you.」
